english.note: For the ordinary flat cooking-pan sense, this is the all-purpose choice among these cookware terms.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a shallow, flat-bottomed frying pan.

examples.english: I use a pan to fry two eggs.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ping4 dai2 wok6 zin1 loeng5 zek3 daan6

examples.english: I fried two eggs in a frying pan.
examples.traditional: 我用平底鑊煎咗兩隻蛋。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ping4 dai2 wok6 zin1 zo2 loeng5 zek3 daan2
